model: First parsed coordinate model;retain every DSSPassigned residue in the denominator. Broad helix=H+G+I;beta=E+B;all remaining DSSPclasses remain in the denominator. The report gives percentages,not residue counts.
target: Return broad-helix andbeta fractions on0..1,the ratio broad_helix/H-only,and whetherH-onlyunderstates the declared broad-helix fraction bymore than0.05absolute fraction.
scope: Coordinate-based DSSPannotation,not a predicted fold or solution ensemble. No missing residue or SEQRESfill is allowed.
